source_description: The four SAIR Stage-2 released evaluation sets as present in this project's development environment (/tmp/evaluation_*.jsonl). Each record carries eq1_id, eq2_id, equation1, equation2, difficulty, answer.
derivation: released_pairs = every (eq1_id,eq2_id) across all four files; released_hyps = every eq1_id. See build step in PROVENANCE.md.
honest_claim: The held-out cohorts are held out by construction from the OFFICIAL released evaluation sets: our four source files are byte-identical (SHA-256) to the official HuggingFace dataset SAIRfoundation/equational-theories-selected-problems at revision 8050c0c7563c58ab71f9210004133860c87de970 (verified 2026-08-26). The exclusion set (800 pairs / 497 hypotheses) is therefore every released evaluation pair.

official_source.method: curl each file from HF resolve/main and shasum -a 256 vs our frozen copies — all 4 IDENTICAL
